proposals.title: Bounded public pose convergence after a rotated pregrasp timeout
proposals.note: Snippet copied verbatim with tolerance0.015; rotated pregrasp uses cap250 and 0.15m stand-off. Seed102 exercised its intended branch: pregrasp timeout after144 ticks at0.219044m error, repeated identical public pose succeeded after29 ticks at0.003508m. Other four pregrasps succeeded directly. Whole policy passed4/5; seed102 later exhausted three descent timeouts, outside the proposal's free-space pregrasp guarantee. No repair was made.

gaps: The proposal supplies a bounded convergence wrapper, not a complete runtime yaw estimator or cube-stack placement recipe; the verifier derived yaw from the live top-cloud minimum bounding rectangle and placement from target surface and cube width.

Seed102 later failed at descent with three typed timeouts (126/120/120 ticks; final positional errors0.014757/0.014545/0.014422m). Reissuing a contact-stage pose does not establish successful convergence; the free-space pregrasp claim should remain narrowly scoped.
notes: One immutable policy, no v02 because4/5 threshold reached. Successful seeds101/103/104/105 used475/423/477/444 ticks, verified public post-lift retention, and final images show red cube stacked on green. Seed102 used569 ticks and stopped before close. This verifies same-task transmission, not causal ablation or cross-task generalization.
